evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build` in site/. These are real scripts in site/package.json: test runs pretest/prepare-data, and build runs svelte-check plus vite build. They run on `pull_request` and on push to main, with top-level `permissions: contents: read`. There is no pull_request_target, and the PR title goes through env and is never interpolated into the script (step1.patch 117-134). pages.yml triggers on push to main, plus `workflow_dispatch`, which can be started from any branch and has no ref guard; only the github-pages environment rule limits it. Pages permissions are least: contents read at the top, and pages/id-token write only on the deploy job. release.yml needs contents: write and uses only github.token. However, no action is pinned to a commit SHA: `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4`, `actions/configure-pages@v5`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3` and `actions/deploy-pages@v4` all use moving tags (step1.patch 90, 92, 169, 171, 180, 194, 210, 247, 251). That is a direct miss on a stated requirement. Nothing was run or pushed.
evidence.s1_readme: The README (step1.patch 512-625) covers Install (Node 22 from .nvmrc, `cd site && npm ci`), Develop (`npm run dev`), Test (`npm test`, with vitest covering site/src and ../lib per the vite.config.ts test include), Build (`npm run build`, `npm run preview`, PAGES_BASE, which vite.config.ts:11 reads) and a script table. Every listed script (prepare-data, index, fieldsets, sample-bullets) exists in site/package.json. It also covers data contribution by family directory, bullets with sources, and targets, and states the license (MIT, which matches LICENSE) with a link to THIRD-PARTY.md. Its claim that site/ holds the only package.json is true.
evidence.s1_release: Strategy, in CONTRIBUTING.md: SemVer, with the version kept only in site/package.json and its lockfile. The release steps are `npm version X.Y.Z --no-git-tag-version`, rename Unreleased, commit `chore(release): X.Y.Z`, then tag vX.Y.Z on main. release.yml enforces all of this: the tag must be on main, must equal package.json and the lockfile, and needs a non-empty changelog section, which becomes the release notes. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and has an Unreleased section. Dependabot covers npm in /site and github-actions, weekly, grouped, with `chore`/`ci` prefixes that fit the convention. The convention is Conventional Commits plus a `data` type, stated in CONTRIBUTING and the README and checked by CI on PR titles. All 7 commits in commits.txt follow it.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route: `#/compare/<a>/<b>` is parsed with decodeURIComponent and has an href builder, so it survives a reload (router.ts). The SVG has role=img and aria-label from 'compare.profiles' = 'Profiles of {a} and {b}', with one <path> per case (Compare.svelte). The table has a caption 'Dimensions ({unit})' giving mm or in, and headers Symbol / names / Difference; symbols come from FIELD_LABELS, values from the cartridge part only, with Tol fields and FIELD_UNITS fields excluded and Difference = B - A (compare.ts). Units follow unitSystem(): formatValue for metric, displayNumber for inches. The detail page has a 'Compare with' Label+NativeSelect sorted by name and a 'Compare' button setting href.compare(key, chosen) (Cartridge.svelte). German strings are given and shot cartridges are refused. One partial: metric differences go through displayNumber (toPrecision(12)), not formatValue, so they are rounded, while the spec says metric is written with formatValue 'no rounding' and differences 'the same way'.
evidence.s2_correctness: overlayProfiles builds one viewportFor over both caseOuterProfile outputs. The head face is at z=0 for both, so it lands at the same x, and fullSectionPath mirrors both around one axis. The tests check equal min-x, a shared axis at height/2 and a length difference of (66.55-51.18)*4. dimensionsOf walks GROUP_ORDER.cartridge, skips arrays, non-numbers, Tol fields and FIELD_UNITS fields (angles, pressures), and keys by label. The test values match the 308 Win. record (L3 51.18, eMin 1.4). Imperial differences convert the mm difference, which is correct. Unknown keys fall to the {:catch} through load()'s rejection, and an undrawable or shotshell record shows a message rather than crashing. The only deviation is the 12-significant-digit rounding of metric differences (16.159999999999997 shown as 16.16).
evidence.s2_fit: The drawing reuses lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile) and lib/geom/svg (viewportFor, fullSectionPath, fmt) in a small new lib/render2d/compare.ts exported from the index. The table reuses lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, toleranceFor, formatValue) and units.ts displayNumber. The page reuses the shadcn Label, NativeSelect and Button, the router/href pattern, the lazy chunk in App.svelte and metadata.ts. Styles follow the `@layer legacy` + `[data-ui=...]` idiom. One small duplication: compare.ts:267 re-implements the group ordering of site/src/lib/fields.ts orderedGroups, and the table CSS copies GroupTable's. The change touches only the needed files.
evidence.s2_tests: lib/render2d/compare.test.ts checks the paths against fullSectionPath on a shared viewport, closed outlines, the aligned head face and axis, scale via the length difference, fitting the viewBox, and refusing shotshell and undrawable records. site/src/lib/compare.test.ts checks row symbols and order, exclusions (Tol, angles, pressures, chamber E), metric values and B-A, float noise, imperial values, symmetry and non-numeric groups. router.test.ts adds round-trip and malformed-hash cases. The tests use the repo's vitest and the CARTRIDGES fixtures. Not covered: the accessible names, column headers and detail-page select, but the repo has no component-test setup.
evidence.s3_fixes: Point 1: compareRows now unions both symbol lists, inserting B-only symbols after their predecessor in B's order, and leaves the cell and Difference empty when one side lacks the value (step3.patch 82-107). Tests assert delta L {a:'0.1', b:'', difference:''} and R3 {a:'', b:'13.51'}, including in imperial. The lede and 'none' texts that said 'both publish' were updated in EN and DE, which is a consequence of the fix and not an unrelated change. Point 2: there is no code change, because step 2 already had `th, td { text-align: right }` with only `th:first-child, td.symbol` left-aligned and class=num on the value cells and headers (step2.patch 653-658), matching GroupTable.svelte:231-245. The outcome is correct, but nothing in the commit records that point 2 was checked.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 added an Unreleased > Added changelog line, and step 3 amended that unreleased entry, which is right under Keep a Changelog for an unreleased feature. Per the stated strategy the version only changes at release, so leaving 0.1.0 is consistent. The commits `feat(site): add a view comparing two cartridges` and `fix(site): list dimensions only one compared cartridge publishes` follow the convention and the 72-character limit. The new code uses the existing aliases and types (the de map is typed Record<keyof en>), and nothing visible would fail test or svelte-check.

unmet_requirements: Step 1: GitHub Actions are pinned to version tags (@v4/@v5/@v3), not full commit SHAs
Step 2 (partly): metric differences are written with displayNumber (toPrecision 12) instead of formatValue without rounding
strengths: A complete, self-consistent release process: the version lives only in site/package.json, and release.yml enforces tag = version = changelog section and that the tag is on main, with Keep a Changelog and Conventional Commits stated and followed in all commits
The compare view reuses lib/shapes2d, lib/geom/svg and lib/core instead of re-deriving geometry or field rules, with a small render2d module and clean router/i18n/metadata integration
Meaningful unit tests check geometry alignment, scale, row selection, units, float noise and router edge cases against real records; the step 3 fix is precise and tested
issues: None of the actions in ci.yml, pages.yml or release.yml is pinned to a commit SHA, which leaves the release job (contents: write) and the Pages deploy open to a moved tag
pages.yml also allows `workflow_dispatch` from any branch with no ref guard; only the github-pages environment's branch rule keeps it to main

Metric differences are rounded with toPrecision(12) through displayNumber instead of being written with formatValue as the spec states; there is also small duplication of group ordering (orderedGroups) and of GroupTable's table CSS
review.verdict: The work is well-structured: the README, release strategy and convention are coherent and actually enforced, and the compare feature reuses the existing libraries correctly with solid tests and a precise step 3 fix. The clear miss is that no workflow action is pinned to a commit SHA, so I would ask for that change, plus a ref guard on the Pages dispatch, before merging.
